coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: 255 Berry
record.summary: A seven-story building at 255 Berry St.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against DataSF's Assessor parcel data), so no single blklot represents the whole building and the building cannot be mapped from a single Assessor parcel the way a single-owner building can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same pattern already used for Mission Bay's other condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon I, Madrone and Radiance, re-checked against the same parcel data in September 2026; Avalon II and III are not condo-mapped, and Arden and One Mission Bay were not re-checked).

milestones.text: 255 Berry completed -- developer's own project page gives a 2001-2004 development date range; $60,000,000 project cost, 99 units, architect McLarand Vasquez Emsiek & Partners

sources.title: Signature Development Group's own project page (signaturedevelopment.com/development/255-berry/)

changes.text: The map notes called the developer Signature Properties and said the building was built in 2004; the developer's own page says Signature Development Group and gives a 2001-2004 development range, so a dated correction was added. The 'Signature I' naming and the milestone's 'Channel Park Condominiums' name are not on any cited page and were removed. The notes now give the 99 units and the architect from the developer's project page, which is cited for the residential use.

Its summary is limited to what its cited source was re-read to confirm that day; fuller details given in this record's other notes (developer, architect, unit count, year built) were left out of the summary where that source didn't state them.
